products.name: Krea AI
products.note: Real-time video generation; creative tool; content moderation; emerging platform

profile_text.body:
Krea is a creative AI platform that describes itself as "the world's most powerful creative AI suite," offering tools to generate, edit, and enhance images and videos. The platform aggregates a range of third-party frontier models alongside its own, including video models from ByteDance (Seedance Studio, Seedance 2.0 Mini), MiniMax (Hailuo), Google (Veo and Gemini 3.1 Flash Image), Alibaba, and others, as well as image models including a Qwen-based option and the FLUX 3 model, which the site describes as capable of rendering up to 20 seconds of video with multilingual speech and audio in a single pass.

Krea's own first-party model is Krea 2, described as a foundation image model built from scratch with a focus on aesthetics, style transfer, and creative control. According to the site, Contra Labs benchmarked Krea 2 Large within 0.14 points of GPT Image 2 on Style Fidelity in a four-model style-transfer benchmark. The platform is tracked under the video generation and editing category, with the Krea AI product noted for real-time video generation and content moderation capabilities.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for Krea.
